decision_requested.reason: Copernicus DEM uses EGM2008 orthometric heights, while the ArcGIS SAR GEOID switch uses EGM96 and NONE is valid only for an ellipsoidal-height DEM.

required_arcgis_component.product: ArcGIS Coordinate Systems Data for ArcGIS Pro
required_arcgis_component.version_compatibility: must match the installed ArcGIS Pro 3.7.x release

preconversion.tool: ArcGIS Project Raster with vertical transformation enabled
preconversion.output_vertical_crs: WGS 1984 ellipsoidal height, ArcGIS VCS WKID 115700
preconversion.transformation_direction: EGM2008 orthometric to WGS84 ellipsoidal; require ArcGIS runtime to list and record the exact reverse-direction transformation before execution
preconversion.horizontal_crs_policy: retain EPSG:4326 during vertical conversion; project later processing outputs to EPSG:32645 under the radar contract
preconversion.attempt_policy: versioned append-only attempt; refuse any existing destination

egm96_builtin_route.permitted_role: labeled sensitivity only after Sentinel inputs pass all earlier gates

required_before_conversion: ArcGIS Pro version and license still match the reviewed runtime
Dataset_egm2008-1.grd exists and is locally SHA-256 bound
ArcGIS lists the expected EGM2008 transformation over the exact approved AOI extent
the exact transformation direction is recorded as EGM2008 orthometric to WGS84 ellipsoidal
all four source DEM hashes still match their promoted custody receipts
the output attempt path is absent and remains outside Git
required_after_conversion: all four derived rasters have append-only receipts and local SHA-256
output vertical CRS is WGS84 ellipsoidal and horizontal CRS remains EPSG:4326
all approved AOIs retain finite non-NoData coverage
spot checks satisfy h = H + N within a declared numeric tolerance
void-fill, seam, artifact, and terrain-plausibility review is recorded
the radar processing contract is updated to select NONE only for the verified ellipsoidal derivatives
stop_on: component, grid, transformation name, direction, extent, license, or installed ArcGIS version differs
interactive My Esri sign-in, license acceptance, UAC, or installer action requires owner control
source hash or custody inventory differs
output collision, source write, untracked sidecar, or path escape
invalid AOI coverage, implausible height correction, seam/artifact failure, or missing verification receipt

actions_authorized_if_approved_and_recon: record the exact EGM2008 preconversion route as the selected production method
after the owner separately installs the reviewed ArcGIS Coordinate Systems Data feature, re-run the local capability inspection
prepare and validate no-overwrite conversion controls bound to the installed grid and four verified DEM hashes
create derived ellipsoidal DEM copies only in the declared external non-Git root
set ArcGIS SAR geoid parameters to NONE only when those verified ellipsoidal copies are used
retain EGM96 GEOID processing only as a labeled sensitivity route
actions_not_authorized: sign in to My Esri or another account
accept or modify any Esri license or provider terms
download or install software or coordinate-system data
approve or dismiss UAC or another privileged prompt
acquire an NGA, PROJ, Sentinel Hub, or other alternate geoid grid
alter or overwrite any promoted Copernicus DEM tile
use raw EGM2008 orthometric tiles with NONE
call the ArcGIS EGM96 GEOID route exact EGM2008 handling
run radar processing before Sentinel custody, container, materialization, pixel, orbit, and registration gates pass
publish a scientific change, interpretation, attribution, or emergency-guidance claim
activation_effect: Approval selects the exact EGM2008 one-minute preconversion method and permits its controlled implementation only after the owner separately installs the matching ArcGIS component. It does not authorize installation, terms acceptance, Sentinel transfer, orbit acquisition, radar execution before prerequisites, or a scientific claim.
